I wanted to get PPF (Paint Protection Film) done on my Mercedes E200. I had previously gotten my new Tucson protected at another extremely well-known dealer, so logically, I should have returned to the same place.

But this time, I wanted to explore other options—especially ones that were more cost-effective (since the car is not new) without compromising on quality.

They carefully inspected my car and, since it wasn’t brand new, pointed out a few scratches and some minor paint irregularities. I appreciated the honesty—but what really surprised me was when they said, “Sir, don’t worry—we’ll get this fixed to perfection, at no extra cost.”

I was admittedly a bit apprehensive at first—but when I saw the final result, I was honestly blown away. I found myself wondering whether I should drive the car or just park it and admire how stunning it looked. No exaggeration—it looked better than the day I took delivery.

Massive shoutout to Yash and the entire team. If you’re even slightly considering where to get PPF done, go meet him—you won’t regret it.

Highly recommended. Solid 10/10.
